notes.title: Elephantasy: Flipside v1.4.2 Update
notes.content:
​Hey all! One more little update with some tweaks/fixes today. Nothing super groundbreaking, but there are a few QoL changes to address. As mentioned last time, patches will be slowing down significantly over the next little while, as this update addresses some of the last bugs/issues I have on my to-do list. IN any case, let's get into the patches this time!
[i]
[b]ELEPHANTASY: FLIPSIDE v1.4.2 PATCHNOTES[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a ceiling to the room Kilderkin in the Castle Sewers. Previously the lack of a ceiling made it possible to clip through walls, among other things. This should now be fixed. [b]Note that this change will only affect new save files; if you're playing on a file from before this update, this change will not apply to you unless you start a new game.[/b]
[*] ​Fixed a bug with warping while small and underwater. Previously, the cosmetic bubble from the bubble item wasn't being drawn in the correct position relative to Belle when being carried. This has been corrected.
[*] Fixed a typo in one of Ludos' hints.
[*] Tweaked Ludos' hints so he will more frequently tell you useful info, as opposed to flavour text.
[*] Tweaked Death's hints so that they will [b]always[/b] direct new players to the Ruined Palace if they haven't found any Lost Souls. The other possible hints have been moved to appear after you've found at least one soul.
[/list][/i]

notes.title: Elephantasy: Flipside v1.4.1 Update
notes.content:
Hi all. More bugfixes/tweaks today! Not much to say other than that; if you missed[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2284310/view/3674412292108176573?l=english] yesterday's update[/url] it'd be a good idea to check it out, since it's a fairly significant one! Otherwise, let's get into today's changes.

[i][b]ELEPHANTASY: FLIPSIDE v1.4.1 PATCHNOTES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug involving using portals and dashing in the Lighthouse. You will now immediately stop dashing when entering a portal.
[*] Tweaked ghost spawning; this was originally going to be in yesterday's update, but I forgot, so I put it in this one instead. Previously, ghosts wouldn't appear in the world until you talked to Death once in the underworld. Because this was annoying to some players, they'll now be out in the world regardless.
[*] Tweaked how items are saved. This should help mitigate losing progress in the event of a game crash.
[*] [strike]Tweaked the tutorial/early game. Now Polnareff the parrot will fly in the direction of the Needle Chamber whenever you enter a room. Hopefully this, in addition to the existing hints from Ludos, will help new players figure out where to go.[/strike]
[*] Fixed a false-positive room border in Trench Chasm. [b]Note that this change will only affect new save files; if you're playing on a file from before this update, this change will not apply to you unless you start a new game.[/b]
[*] UPDATE: Removed the tweaked tutorial and simply changed the color of the Needle Chamber doorway. I wasn't particularly happy with the changes, and honestly, I liked the start of the game just fine, so we're back to square one. [b]I will not be changing the tutorial further.[/b]
[*] UPDATE: Changed how respawning after drowning works.
[*] UPDATE: Fixed a bug where you could call Polnareff during a certain cutscene, causing issues with saving.
[*] UPDATE: Tweaked two rooms in the ruins to avoid a softlock. [b]Note that this change will only affect new save files; if you're playing on a file from before this update, this change will not apply to you unless you start a new game.[/b]
[*] UPDATE: Fixed the wall jump tutorial NPC after the 1.4 changes to props bouncing off of walls. After a pep talk, they now have a spring in their step once again.
[*] UPDATE: Fixed bug where Rocky and Duke wouldn't spawn normally without talking to Death, as a holdover from before the above changes to ghost spawning was implemented.
[*] UPDATE: Fixed bug with respawning after dying in the room Aquarium. Previously, dying in the room without the bubble item would cause the player to respawn infinitely in the previous room, since it wasn't considered a valid respawn point. Now players will respawn in the last valid respawn room they were in.
[/list]

[/i]

notes.title: Elephantasy: Flipside v1.4 Update
notes.content:
Hey gang! The game's been out for a whole week! Thank you to everyone who has bought the game already, and I hope you're all enjoying your time playing! I've been doing pretty regular bugfixes over this week, mostly in response to player feedback, but after this update I'll probably be slowing down unless there are major issues that need resolving. As always, however, feel free to report bugs to me via email or in the Steam discussion about the game. Now, onto the changes for 1.4!

[i][b]ELEPHANTASY: FLIPSIDE v1.4 PATCHNOTES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed hard-lock where players would get stuck in the ceiling and be unable to escape. You should now automatically die and respawn if stuck in this way.
[*] Fixed bug where players could drop held items during cutscenes/when they otherwise shouldn't be allowed to do so. Now players should only be able to drop held items when they are in total control.
[*] Changed how [b]lifting[/b] items like Keys, Gems, and Ore works. Previously, if you had the ring equipped to the primary item slot (E or B) it would auto-collect the item, whereas if you had it equipped to the secondary item slot (Q or X) it would lift it up instead. Now, if you have the ring equipped and use it, you will lift the item instead of automatically collecting it, regardless of which slot the ring is equipped to. 
[*] Changed the height boost thrown props would get when bouncing off of walls. It should now be marginally less silly and less prone to bugging out.
[*] Tweaked wall jumping in conjunction with the magnifying lens. It should now be impossible (or at least significantly harder) to wall jump off of the same wall repeatedly for infinite height. Again, sorry Sylvie.
[*] Fixed ANOTHER bug where a certain NPC would be removed from the game prematurely if certain actions are done. This should no longer happen.
[*] Removed extra herbs in the herb garden that would appear after the quest was completed. Now you should always get one herb per plant. [b]Note that this change will only affect new save files; if you're playing on a file from before this update, this change will not apply to you unless you start a new game.[/b]
[*] Tweaked cooking pot in Hidden Village that would spawn after picking up the nearby key. Now it should always be present in the room, regardless of the state of the key. [b]Note that this change will only affect new save files; if you're playing on a file from before this update, this change will not apply to you unless you start a new game.[/b]
[*] Tweaked a room in the Ruins which could be used to get to a certain collectible early. This should no longer be possible. [b]Note that this change will only affect new save files; if you're playing on a file from before this update, this change will not apply to you unless you start a new game.[/b]
[*] UPDATE:​ Fixed the getting stuck in the ceiling again, because the initial changes didn't work. Everything should now behave correctly! And if it doesn't, I'll cry!
[/list]

[/i]

notes.title: Elephantasy: Flipside v1.3.2 Update
notes.content:
​Hey gang! Not a ton to report today, but I have one major bug and a few minor tweaks to address. Also, if you downloaded the game/updates yesterday and found your game crashing, that has been fixed as of last night, though you'll have to download the latest version for those fixes to take effect. Thank you all so much for your patience and goodwill, and I hope you continue to enjoy Flipside!

[i][b]ELEPHANTASY: FLIPSIDE v1.3.2 PATCHNOTES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where a certain NPC would disappear forever if you went the wrong way in the final area. They should now reappear where you first found them if you lead them astray. That said, any save files that previously encountered this may be stuck without the NPC in question. If this has happened to you, I've included a detailed description of how to fix this for yourself below.
[*] Fixed height for plucking Daikon​ being inconsistent with their height.
[*] Tweaked the room Burning Steel to (hopefully)​ make the puzzle solution more apparent. This change will only affect new save files.​
[*] UPDATE: Fixed bug with 100% where it would only give you the achievement if you completed Ending #3 with 100% completion, and gave the wrong text in the final score wrap-up. Now the game gives the achievement whenever you end the game with 100% completion, regardless of the ending, and gives the correct text.
[*] UPDATE: Fixed bug where picking up a prop on a room transition would sometimes crash the game.
[/list]
[/i]
To fix the NPC not respawning if you have already removed them from your game:

[olist]
[*] Locate your game save. This should be in your local appdata folder on your computer. Also locate where STEAM has stored the game's files; the latter should be in a folder labelled "Elephantasy_Flipside_STEAM".
[*] Open the "Elephantasy_Flipside_STEAM" folder, and find the folder labelled "rooms_default". Also find the folder labelled "rooms" in your save data.
[*] Open "rooms_default" and find a file labelled "roomdata-6,0,-22.ini". [i][u]Copy[/u][/i] that folder to the "rooms" folder in your save data. This will effectively reset the room's state, allowing you to access the NPC again.
[*] In your save data, open "gamedata.ini" in a text editor (notepad is okay). Find the entry labelled "keys" and add one to the corresponding number. This will let you open up the lock in the room where the NPC is trapped without using up a key. If you have Death's Key, you can skip this step.
[*] In "gamedata.ini", also find the entry labelled "itemmax". If this number is greater than the number of ghosts​ you've collected plus one, set it to the number of ghosts you've collected plus one. For instance, if you have 5 ghosts, and your "itemmax" says 7, set it to 6.
[/olist]

notes.title: Elephantasy: Flipside v1.3.1 Update
notes.content:
​Well, I guess you guys are lucky because you get TWO big-ish updates today! Earlier I released a patch to fix some issues with coyote time, and some of the new code was buggy and caused crashing. That has now been fixed, thankfully, along with a few QoL changes:
[i]
[b]ELEPHANTASY: FLIPSIDE v1.3.1 PATCHNOTES[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where the game would crash when it wasn't sure what you were standing on, causing it to throw a fit. 
[*]​ Changed how the Whistle works. Normally, when using it, you can hold the jump button while flying to cycle through unlocked warps. Now, in addition to that, simply using the whistle while in a warp room will send you to the next one in the list, looping at the end.
[*] Made the key in the mountain trading post come back if you enter the room and have no keys.
[*] Changed the starting amount of green herbs in your satchel. Now players starting a new game will start with 3, not just 1, in order to offset accidental/experimental use and allow players to more easily complete the herb sidequest.
[/list][/i]

notes.title: Elephantasy: Flipside v1.3 Update
notes.content:
Hey all. Boy, the work sure never ends over here, huh? Just a few more bugfixes today, but they're fairly important so I figured I'd add them to a new update. As an aside, I added a few smaller bugfixes throughout the day yesterday to the v1.2 patchnotes, so if you're curious about any of those little updates, check there. Thank you all for your patience with Flipside, and I hope you're all still enjoying it!

[i][b]ELEPHANTASY: FLIPSIDE v1.3 PATCHNOTES[/b][/i]

[i][list]
[*] Fixed bug with swapping/grabbing items in Death's Palace and the final area, where they could be collected when in proximity to the player regardless of their height differences. Now objects can only be swapped if they're close enough to the player's height.
[*] Fixed bug where the game would hard lock and force a s&q if the map was opened while you were dying outside in the game world. Now the player's control should return normally when closing the map/respawning.
[*] Fixed bug where respawning in certain rooms (particularly in the final area) would occasionally displace the player and cause them to fall out of bounds. This was due to differences in floor height and the expected respawn floor height. This [b]should[/b] no longer happen, at least in this context.
[*] Fixed bug where opening and closing the inventory precisely on a vertical room border would sometimes load the new room while not removing the old one, leading to two rooms being loaded on top of each other simultaneously. Now the game should [b]only[/b] go through the motions of loading a room if the inventory is closed.
[*] UPDATE: Fixed bug where the player would gain infinite height while trading gems/ore/items while small. Now they should only bounce while on the ground.
[*] UPDATE: Fixed bug where coyote time could be abused to jump infinitely. Coyote time should now behave itself.
[*] UPDATE: Fixed bug where pausing and unpausing in some circumstances allowed players to dash on ice without upgraded boots.
[*] UPDATE: Fixed typo in one of Ludos' hints. In his defense, he IS a dog.
[/list][/i]

notes.title: Elephantasy: Flipside v1.2 Update
notes.content:
Hey all! Another slightly larger round of bugfixes/patches in the wake of our release. A certain other gamedev and lime enthusiast decided to give the game a try and... oh boy, did she find things. As stated above, hopefully tomorrow won't have another one of these, but if it does, so be it.

[i][b]ELEPHANTASY: FLIPSIDE v1.2 PATCHNOTES[/b][/i]
[i][list]
[*] Fixed bug where players could stand on items in Death's palace and swap them to gain infinite height. Now there's a delay before you can swap items again, which should stop this.
[*] Fixed bug with in-game text hints not displaying the correct buttons sometimes after remapping. They should now be accurate.
[*] Removed bug where players could spam-use the wand in corners to gain infinite height in some situations. Now the wand should only give you a height boost when you're on solid ground.
[*] Removed extra Ore in the Highland Bandit Fort that would spawn after collecting the Gem. As nice as this was, it screws up the tallies for 100% completion, so it's been axed.[b] This change should only affect new save games though, so if you're playing one from before this, hey, free ore.[/b]
[*] Removed screenshake when props hit the ceiling of rooms. This would cause some situations where, if a prop got stuck up there, it would constantly be shaking the room.
[*] Tweaked wall jumping so that it's impossible (or at least harder) to gain infinite height with corners or in 1x1 tile gaps. Other applications of wall jumping [b]should[/b] be unchanged. Sorry Sylvie.
[*] UPDATE:  Fixed bug where a lost soul would reappear in a room after starting to follow the player, allowing them to amass multiple souls at once.
[*] UPDATE: Tweaked height gain for summoning Polnareff the parrot; same height boost restrictions imposed as with the wand, as noted above.
[*] UPDATE: Fixed a clip through the fence around the Palace of Death. [b]This change should also only affect new save games, so if you're playing one from before this, there will be no changes to the affected room.[/b]
[*] UPDATE: Added a button prompt for a special interaction with specific props and the Magnifying Lens. This should (hopefully) make this mechanic easier for new players to pick up on.
[/list]
[/i]

notes.title: Elephantasy: Flipside v1.1 Update
notes.content:
Hey all! Thank you for purchasing Elephantasy: Flipside so close to launch, and for all of the support! I know it's still very early on, but I have a few (minor) bugfixes to push through today! I may have more later in the day, so stay tuned!

[i][b]ELEPHANTASY: FLIPSIDE v1.1 PATCHNOTES[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] [i]Fixed bug where the player could "continue" a game before having started a new game, putting them in the void. I could have made this a joke, but it really [b]was[/b] a bug, so I just fixed the associated code. You should now be unable to select "continue" before starting a new game.[/i]
[*] [i]Fixed bug where the player could decapitate Ludos with another prop. Please don't do this. He's a good boy. [i]Can You Pet The Dog?[/i] will take away my gaming license. Ludos' head should now stay fixed to his body, except when bouncing.[/i]
[*] [i]Hopefully(?) fixed a bug concerning time trials with an NPC. Also added indicators for where to go next in the race, to prevent confusion on the part of the player.[/i]
[*] [i]UPDATE: Also tweaked control rebinding so that:
[olist]
[*]No two controls can be bound to the same button at once.
[*]Controls can now be reset to the defaults by pressing the Inventory button (Default TAB or Y) while not rebinding.
[/olist]
[*][i]UPDATE #2: Fixed an issue with collision in one room the Volcano area. This change will only affect newly started games, so if you've started a game and you find an out of bounds area, know that it's been fixed for future playthroughs.[/i]
[/i]
[/list]
